capabilities: Extract a named saved view from a .base file as a fenced base query
Preview the complete query with shared definitions before insertion
Insert the query at the cursor or copy it to the clipboard
Warn about expressions that depend on the target note's context
Batch-extract several views into headed sections and save named presets (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a Bases viewer or editor; it only copies a saved view's query source, not the result rows.
extras: Freemium: extracting one view is free; multi-view sections and presets require a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors sponsorship. After updates the plugin opens a promotional 'What's new' tab (disable in settings). Desktop-only testing; mobile, Linux and third-party themes untested. Plugin not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Enable the core Bases plugin to render the inserted query.
problem: Obsidian's Bases has no built-in way to reuse one saved view from a large Base elsewhere; you would have to find and copy each filter and formula by hand.

relations.evidence: Enable the core Bases plugin to render the inserted query.

summary: Copies a named saved view from a .base file into a complete embedded fenced base query for insertion into any Markdown note.
